source_rule_flipped: uses the other set of counting sources
defaults_count: treats any non-None source (incl. defaults) as provided
string_split_into_chars: turns a plain string into a tuple of characters
reports_last_pair: reports the last conflicting pair instead of the first
pair_order_swapped: reports the named parameter before the declaring one
checked_during_resilient: runs the check during resilient parsing
self_reference_not_ignored: does not ignore a parameter naming itself
